comparison.objective: Empty used capsules and restore a capsule machine with a fresh capsule.
comparison.physical_skill: Bulk transfer loose capsules, fit a collector, seat a fresh capsule, and close the machine.
comparison.success_condition: Seven used capsules in recycling tray, collector fitted, fresh capsule seated, head closed, hands released, stable 1 s.
comparison.reason: This includes loose-object transfer but no aperture-based selective separation, retained workpieces, or bridge clearing. The record gives thresholds but only a terse drop/invalid failure definition.
